inherits_from_v1.note: Same constructed generator, both registered scenarios (base, regime_flip_at_75pct), same folds, labels, inner validation, portfolio rule, lag and cost ledger. The data generator is unchanged; no tree-favouring scenario is added to Project 6.

baseline_rerun_check: v1 baselines are recomputed with the unchanged ml_pipeline code and must reproduce the A8-A c3 summary numbers (qa/a8/ch37_ch39_batch/rework_r2/evidence/rw_qa2/p06_base and p06_regime summary.json) (prediction metrics and net portfolio metrics) to 1e-12 relative; a mismatch stops the run.

model_notes.gbm: HistGradientBoostingRegressor with early_stopping=False; max_iter is an upper bound and the number of rounds is chosen jointly with the other parameters on the inner date-grouped validation folds (staged predictions); refit on all outer training rows with the chosen rounds.
model_notes.pca_ridge: Auxiliary ablation (Chapter 41): scaler + PCA + Ridge fitted on outer training rows only; tests whether the high-variance directions of the features carry the signal.
model_notes.missing: Same as v1: rows with any missing feature or label are dropped from training and counted; test rows with a missing feature get no prediction (flat).

seeds.note: Seeds drive bootstrap/feature sampling (rf), tie-breaking (tree) and permutation draws; HistGradientBoosting with early_stopping=False is deterministic given the data.

inner.method: permutation within each signal date (cross-sectional), MSE increase and mean daily Spearman IC drop
inner.window: last inner validation fold of each outer fold (63 signal dates inside the outer training rows)
inner.model: chosen parameters (and rounds) fitted on that inner fold's training rows

post_hoc_test.method: same permutation on each outer test window with the final fold model
post_hoc_test.use: diagnostic only; never fed back into model, parameter or feature choice for that or any test window

mdi.use: impurity importance of the final rf model per fold, reported only to show its bias against permutation importance

variants.top10_inner: per fold keep the 10 features with the largest inner permutation MSE increase; parameters as chosen on the full set (registered simplification)

ablations.groups_defined_by: data source (price-derived vs characteristic file), which a researcher knows without seeing the generator; the signal/noise split of q_* vs noise_* is NOT used to define any variant

fold: inner importance rank correlation between consecutive folds

report: prediction metrics and net-10bp metrics per seed
pairwise correlation of predictions between seeds

comparison.primary_statistic: difference in mean daily Spearman IC (model minus ridge) on the common evaluated dates, Newey-West t with lags h-1 = 4
secondary: net-of-cost Sharpe at 10 bp and 20 bp
comparison.multiplicity: 3 tree models x 2 scenarios plus ablations and seeds; no correction is applied, all comparisons are descriptive; nothing is called significant on this constructed data
comparison.claims_rule: No economic or alpha claim; accuracy or importance ranks are never read as alpha; every zero and negative result is reported.

real_data: blocked (data_manifest.json); --data real exits 3 and writes nothing
